title: Agentmandering: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Fair Redistricting via Large Language Model Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a game-theoretic redistricting negotiation (Choose-and-Freeze protocol) between two LLM agents representing opposing political parties, and evaluating the resulting district maps using mathematical metrics such as Partisan Bias (average deviation from parity between vote share and seat share) and Local Unfairness (the proportion of voters whose preferred party did not win in their district).
